Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 58851 of 2022
Applicant :- Umesh Tripathi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vishveshwar Mani Tripathi,Surendra Mohan Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.
Heard Sri Vishveshwar Mani Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Suresh Bahadur Singh, learned AGA for the State.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
0463 of 2021, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406 IPC, Police Station Ramgadtal, District Gorakhpur during pendency of the trial.
According to the FIR, applicant under the guise to provide job to informant received rupees two lacs cash from informant and Rs. 70,000/- was transferred by the informant in the account of co-accused Devendra Sharma.
It is further mentioned in the FIR that Rs. 1 lakh was also given to the father of co -accused Devendra Sharma.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is false and baseless and applicant never induced the informant to provide him job.

He further submitted that there is no allegation against the applicant that he received any money in his account Umesh Tripathi vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110620119/
1 and only allegation against the applicant is that Rs. 2 lakh cash was given to him, which is totally false and except the verbal allegation there is no evidence on record, which can substantiate the allegation that applicant taken Rs. 2 lakh.

sentences.text: He further submitted that from the FIR, it appears that main accused was Devendra Sharma @ Devendra Nath Pandey, in whose account Rs. 70,000/- was transferred, has already been enlarged on anticipatory bail on 04.11.2022 in Criminal Misc.

Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. 10355 of 2022 and co-accused Meena Tripathi who as per FIR provided fake appointment letter has also released on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 15.12.2022 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 53314 of 2022

sentences.text: . He next submitted that applicant has no criminal history although in the rejection order it is alleged that he is having criminal history of three cases but he stated in paragraph no. 2 of the supplementary affidavit that in two cases applicant was not wanted and only co-accused Devendra Sharma was accused and in one case final report was submitted and applicant is in jail since 03.09.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that except the allegation that applicant also received Rs. 2 lakh in cash there is no other allegation against the applicant and there is no evidence on record, which can show that applicant has taken Rs. 2 lakh from informant.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of record, it appears that although there is allegation against the applicant that he also received Rs. 2 lakh from the informant under the pretext to provide job but there is no other evidence except the bald allegation that he received Rs. 2 lakh and main accused Devendra Sharma has been released on anticipatory bail and in the present case applicant is in jail since 03.09.2022,
therefore, in view of this Court, it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
In the light of discussions made above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant - Umesh Tripathi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
